name: Tony Devon
bio:
Tony Devon (December 5, 1951 – February 26, 2022) was an American actor born Anthony Acchione in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. Before acting he worked as a singer, including as an opening act for Rodney Dangerfield.

He appeared as one of the sailor's friends in Brian De Palma's Blow Out and went on to more than a hundred film and television roles, including The King of Comedy, 25th Hour, We Own the Night, The Last Days of Lehman Brothers, Law & Order, Spin City, NCIS and White Collar. He was also an executive producer of The Life and Times of Charlie Putz.
